title: Warranties Administrator - Automotive
description:
Warranties Administrator

Hull Full-Time Permanent£28,000 per annum

Our client, a well-established automotive business based in Hull, is seeking a Warranties Administrator to join their busy aftersales team on a full-time, permanent basis.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced automotive administration professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced dealership or workshop environment and takes pride in delivering accurate and efficient administrative support.

The Role

As a Warranties Administrator, you will be responsible for accurately costing and invoicing completed workshop jobs across multiple vehicle brands, ensuring all work is processed correctly and in line with manufacturer and company requirements.

Key responsibilities include:
- Costing completed workshop jobs accurately and efficiently
- Processing service and repair invoices
- Administering warranty claims in line with manufacturer guidelines
- Ensuring all documentation is complete and compliant
- Liaising with workshop, service and parts departments to resolve any discrepancies
- Maintaining accurate records and supporting the wider aftersales function
- Ensuring all submissions and invoicing are completed within required timescales

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have previous experience within the automotive industry in one of the following areas:
- Aftersales Administration
- Service Invoicing
- Warranty Administration
- Workshop Costing
- Dealership Administration

You will also possess:
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational and administrative skills
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workload effectively
- Good communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving
- Confidence working with dealership management systems

Experience using Kerridge would be a distinct advantage.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of £28,000 per annum
- Full-time, permanent position
- Opportunity to join a successful and growing automotive business
- Supportive and professional working environment
- Career development opportunities within the automotive sector

Apply Today

If you have experience in automotive aftersales administration, service invoicing, warranty administration or workshop costing and are looking for your next opportunity in Leeds, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to be considered.

description: Band 2 Administrator Hull Community Diagnostic Centre Part Time Have you ever thought about working for the NHS? Behind every appointment, every clinic, every patient seen - there is someone who made it happen. Our Administrators are the unseen heroes of patient care. The reassuring voice on the phone. The organised mind behind the clinic list. The calm presence supporting patients in what can often be their most worrying moments. Without them, patients don't get seen. Services don't run. Care doesn't flow. We are recruiting an Administrators to join our team at the Community Diagnostic Centre. You don't need previous NHS experience - we can teach you the systems. What we can't teach is compassion, professionalism and the ability to care about getting things right for patients. That's what we're looking for. The role requires flexibility and shifts to cover a 7 day service 8am to 8pm Monday to Sunday. What you'll bring: A caring and compassionate approach Confidence communicating with patients and the public Good organisational skills and attention to detail Basic IT skills (typing, email, data entry, use of computer systems) The ability to work as part of a close-knit team Calmness in a sometimes fast-paced environment What you'll gain: The chance to make a real difference every single day Full and part-time opportunities with flexible working options One of the best pension schemes available Generous annual leave entitlement - because you work hard and deserve proper time off Structured training and ongoing support Genuine career progression - many of our senior leaders began in administrative roles Patient care is at the heart of everything we do, and our administrative teams are central to making that care possible. If you are organised, compassionate, and want a role where your work truly matters, we would love to hear from you. For further details with regard to this vacancy opportunity, please see the attached Job Description and Person Specification. Should we receive a high volume of applications the advert may be closed earlier than stated. Please note that, in line with UKVI regulations, this vacancy does not meet the eligibility criteria for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker Visa route. As a result, we are unable to issue a Certificate of Sponsorship for this position. We remain committed to fair and equal recruitment practices and encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates who have the right to work in the UK.
